official_comparator.commit_membership_basis: Parent source-only GitHub API commit/tree receipt; this worker independently checked local content against both supplied Gitblob IDs and receipt sizes. No independent remote query.

evidence.observation: Registered exact_match is ExactMatch; apply(self,predictions,references) directly compares normalize_text(prediction) and normalize_text(reference). No normalization flag/config parameter or class initializer in this class.

A distinct unregistered utility exact_match(gold,pred) performs trimmed case-sensitive equality, but using it would substitute a different interface for the predeclared registered consumer. It was not invoked or selected.

contract_conflict.requires: Whitespace strip only; preserve case. Official registered exact-match consumer must realize that construct without custom scorer replacement.
contract_conflict.scope: Semantic incompatibility with this selected contract; not an EvalScope bug, benchmark finding, false alert, metric superiority result or evidence about its default suitability.
